status: NOT A CLINICAL OR PSYCHOLOGICAL DIAGNOSIS
NOT READY FOR PRODUCTION PSYCHOMETRIC CLAIMS

decision_rules.construct_preserved: true only when intended-meaning retention and single-construct purity are supported across expert-role runs and persona paraphrases do not show systematic construct shift
decision_rules.no_major_safety_concern: false when a recurring major safety, shame, or judgment concern remains
decision_rules.no_systematic_misinterpretation: true only when no recurring wrong paraphrase is present; classify each of four paraphrases against the stated primary construct and candidate wording
decision_rules.scale_usable: true only when at least three of four personas find options fitting and expert evidence does not show a recurring mismatch
decision_rules.recall_usable: true only when at least three of four personas find recall usable and expert evidence does not show a recurring mismatch
decision_rules.shame_not_increased: compare the revised persona flag count with the source item's first-panel count; true when it does not increase and no major expert safety concern appears
decision_rules.overlap_not_increased: compare second-pass expert moderate/high overlap count with the first-panel expert_moderate_or_high value, accounting for 16 versus 24 runs; true when the proportion does not materially increase
decision_rules.second_pass_gate: pass only when all seven required gates are true; otherwise revise or hold
decision_rules.ab_selection: do not select on style; apply the same gates independently to A and B

controlled_values.counts: non-negative integers; expert gate counts sum to 16; persona correct plus misinterpretation sums to 4
